dedupe_keys.name: a dataset for multiple structural representations of urban road maps across chinese cities

description: A Dataset for Multiple Structural Representations of Urban Road Maps Across Chinese Cities is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Hong Zhang et al. Urban road networks form the backbone of cities, shaping mobility, accessibility, spatial organization and urban form. However, widely used road-network data sources, such as OpenStreetMap, are primarily organized for general geographic representation and navigation-oriented applications, and they often require further processing before they can support systematic urban studies. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2026. Formats: Shapefile, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2425499544 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
